_comment: CAM operator registry. soc_versions maps a SOC generation to the operator directory names it supports. operator_meta holds per-operator build metadata. To support a new SOC generation, add an entry under soc_versions. To add an operator, append its directory name to the relevant soc list and (optionally) add meta. Operator identity = source directory name under ascend_kernels/.

fused_deep_moe_fwk._note: independent operator; files are fused_deep_moe_fwk.*, do NOT conflict with base/w4a8, can coexist

fused_deep_moe_arch35._note: Ascend950/A5 MX path; lives only under ascend950. Shares fused_deep_moe.* filenames with base/w4a8 but different SOC so no mutex.
